capabilities: Open local HTML files in tabs with images, styles, scripts, fonts, audio, and video
Search loaded text across recognized slides and jump between results
Edit per-slide Markdown notes in a sidebar, saved as a normal note
Present the deck in a separate window on an external display while keeping notes on the computer
Embed HTML pages in Markdown notes with configurable width and height
disambiguation: Not an HTML editor; the plugin only previews and presents HTML files and explicitly does not support HTML editing.
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later); mobile not supported. The marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Single HTML files are limited to 64 MiB, and the README includes detailed privacy and security disclosures with a local server bound to 127.0.0.1.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or render local HTML files with their scripts and resources, and offers no way to present an HTML slide deck with separate presenter notes.

relations.evidence: supported fixed-canvas decks, Reveal, Swiper, and mutually exclusive slides with arbitrary or missing IDs
Recognition and navigation are checked separately, using the author's controls and actual results

summary: HTML viewer that opens local HTML files in tabs, recognizes slide decks, adds per-slide notes, presents on an external display, and embeds pages in Markdown.
